en: This postcard image shows a scenic panoramic view of a city, with a river running through the middle and various bridges spanning it. In the foreground, there are stone columns and a wall covered with vines, likely part of a historic building or castle structure. The colors suggest an old, hand-tinted style, typical of early 20th-century postcards. The upper part of the image contains the text 'Graz mit Castellaufgang.'
